# SnapReduce (https://snapreduce.pages.dev)
> Free, private, client-side browser image compression, resizing, format conversion, and dimension calculator tools.

SnapReduce executes 100% of image processing client-side within the user's web browser using modern HTML5 Canvas, Web Worker, and WebAssembly APIs. Photos and documents never touch a remote server, ensuring complete data sovereignty, privacy, and confidentiality for government forms, identity cards, signatures, and personal photographs.

## Core Capabilities & Architecture
- **Exact Target File Size Compression**: Calibrated binary search quantization targeting 50KB, 100KB, 200KB, and 500KB thresholds without distortion.
- **Client-Side Privacy (Zero Server Uploads)**: Images are loaded into browser memory and manipulated via Canvas 2D contexts. No telemetry, no cloud storage, no server transmission.
- **Multi-Format Conversion**: Instant conversion between JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, and Apple HEIC image formats.
- **Precision Dimension Resizing & Aspect Ratio**: Pixel width and height adjustment, percentage scaling, aspect ratio preservation, and DPI calculations.
- **Offline Capable & Fast**: Zero network latency during processing; works instantly on mobile devices and desktops.

### General Compression & Resizing Tools
- [Image Compressor](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/image-compressor/): ✓ Free online image compressor for JPG, PNG, and WebP. Smart target size reduction with zero quality loss and no server uploads. 100% private in browser.
- [JPG Compressor](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/jpg-compressor/): ✓ Compress JPG & JPEG photos online for free. Reduce file size to exact KB targets with zero blur or quality loss. 100% private in-browser compression.
- [PNG Compressor](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/png-compressor/): ✓ Compress PNG images online while keeping transparent backgrounds and razor-sharp text. Fast, free, browser-based optimization with no watermarks.
- [Image Resizer](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/image-resizer/): ✓ Resize image width and height online for free. Lock aspect ratios, scale by percentage, and change DPI without distortion. Instant preview & download.
- [Image Size Converter](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/image-size-converter/): ✓ Convert image file size in KB, MB, and pixel dimensions simultaneously. Accurate, instant client-side processing with zero server uploads or sign-up.
- [Photo Size Reducer](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/photo-size-reducer/): ✓ Shrink camera and mobile phone photos online for free. Perfect for email, WhatsApp, and form uploads with no quality loss. 100% private & instant.
- [Crop Image Online](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/image-cropper/): ✓ Crop images online for free. Includes presets for square (1:1), 4:3, 16:9, and passport photos. Fast, intuitive canvas tool with instant HD download.

### Format Conversion Tools
- [Convert JPG to PNG](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/jpg-to-png/): ✓ Convert JPG and JPEG photos to high-definition PNG format online for free. Crisp rendering, lossless conversion, and zero server uploads in your browser.
- [Convert PNG to JPG](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/png-to-jpg/): ✓ Convert PNG graphics and transparent images to JPG format online for free. Automatic clean white background, fast compression, and zero file uploads.
- [Convert JPG to WebP](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/jpg-to-webp/): ✓ Convert JPG images to modern lightweight WebP format online. Shrink image weight by up to 35% without losing sharpness. Boost website speed instantly.
- [Convert WebP to JPG](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/webp-to-jpg/): ✓ Convert downloaded WebP images to standard JPG format online. Works on all phones, PCs, and software. Free, instant, and 100% private in your browser.
- [Convert HEIC to JPG](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/heic-to-jpg/): ✓ Convert Apple iPhone & iPad HEIC photos to standard JPG format online. Batch ready, ultra-fast, and 100% private with zero cloud uploads or limits.
- [Convert HEIC to PNG](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/heic-to-png/): ✓ Convert iPhone HEIC photos into high-definition PNG format online for free. Preserves crisp colors and transparency with private client-side processing.

### Image Calculators
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/aspect-ratio-calculator/): ✓ Calculate aspect ratios (16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 21:9) and scale proportional width and height dimensions instantly. Free, precise calculator for web and video.
- [Image Dimensions Calculator](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/image-dimensions-calculator/): ✓ Calculate total pixels, megapixels, aspect ratios, and physical print dimensions at 72, 150, and 300 DPI. Free image resolution and size calculator.
- [Image DPI Calculator](https://snapreduce.pages.dev/tools/image-dpi-calculator/): ✓ Calculate DPI, PPI, pixel resolution, and print sizes in inches or cm. Ensure your photos meet exact high-resolution printing and passport standards.
